points.name: 汉语的基本语序
points.explainEn: Basic Chinese word order is usually Subject + Verb + Object.
points.structure: 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语

exercises.q: 排序：汉语 / 我 / 学习

points.note: 初学阶段先掌握最基本的“谁 + 做什么 + 什么”顺序。
points.noteEn: First master the basic order: who + does + what.

points.name: “是”字句
points.explainEn: Use 是 to say that A is B.
points.structure: A + 是 + B
points.note: “是”常连接身份、国籍、名称等；否定是“不是”。
points.noteEn: 是 links identity/nationality/name; the negative is 不是.

points.name: 结构助词“的”
points.explainEn: Use 的 to show possession or connection: “A's B”.
points.structure: A + 的 + B

exercises.q: 翻译：This is Li Wen's phone.
排序：老师 / 我的 / 她 / 是
exercises.body: 老师 / 我的 / 她 / 是

points.note: 本册先掌握最基本的所属关系。
points.noteEn: First master the most basic possessive relationship.

points.name: “吗”疑问句
points.explainEn: Add 吗 at the end of a statement to make a yes/no question.
points.structure: 陈述句 + 吗？

exercises.q: 把句子变成问句：你是老师。

points.note: 句子的基本顺序不变，只在句末加“吗”。
points.noteEn: Keep the basic word order; just add 吗 at the end.

points.name: “有”字句（1）
points.explainEn: Use 有 to say someone has something or that something exists.
points.structure: 主语/地点 + 有 + 名词

examples.en: There are four people in my family.

exercises.q: 翻译：I have an older brother.

points.note: “有”的否定是“没有”，不是“不有”。
points.noteEn: The negative of 有 is 没有, never 不有.

points.name: 数的表达
points.explainEn: Use Chinese numbers to say age, quantity, phone numbers, and more.
points.structure: 数词：一、二/两、三……十、百、千

examples.en: He is twenty years old this year.
There are four people in my family.

points.note: 名词前表示数量时常用“两”，如“两个人、两个孩子”。
points.noteEn: Use 两 (not 二) before a measure word: 两个人, 两个孩子.

points.name: 语气助词“呢”（1）：反问同类信息
points.explainEn: Use 呢 after a person or topic to mean “what about…?”.

examples.en: I have two older brothers. What about you?
I am Chinese. What about you?
My name is Li Wen. What about you?

exercises.q: 翻译：I'm Chinese. What about you?

points.note: 前文已经说过的问题可以用“呢”避免重复。
points.noteEn: Use 呢 to avoid repeating a question already mentioned.

points.name: 名量词和“数词+量词+（名词）”
points.explainEn: Put a measure word between a number and a noun.
points.structure: 数词 + 量词 +（名词）

examples.en: There are four people in my family.

points.note: 本课重点量词包括“个、口”等。
points.noteEn: Key measure words here include 个, 口.

points.name: 时间的表达（1）：日期和星期
points.explainEn: Say dates from large to small: year → month → day/date → weekday.
points.structure: 年 → 月 → 日/号 → 星期
points.note: 口语日期常用“号”，书面也常用“日”。
points.noteEn: Speech uses 号 for dates; writing often uses 日.

points.name: 名词谓语句
points.explainEn: For dates, weekdays, age and similar information, Chinese can use a noun phrase directly as the predicate.
points.structure: 主语 + 日期/星期/年龄

exercises.q: 改错：今天是星期日。（按本课基本句型）
exercises.body: 今天是星期日。（按本课基本句型）

exercises.q: 翻译：He is twenty this year.
排序：九月八号 / 今天

points.note: 本课重点是这些句子可以不用“是”。
points.noteEn: The point: these sentences need no 是.

points.name: 能愿动词“会”
points.explainEn: Use 会 + verb for a skill you learned and know how to do.
points.structure: 主语 + 会 + 动词
points.note: “会”强调通过学习获得的技能。
points.noteEn: 会 stresses a skill gained through learning.

points.name: 能愿动词“想”
points.explainEn: Use 想 + verb to say “want to / would like to”.
points.structure: 主语 + 想 + 动词

examples.en: I want to go to school.
He does not want to watch a movie.

exercises.q: 翻译：He wants to watch a movie.
exercises.body: He wants to watch a movie.

points.note: “想”后面直接接动作。
points.noteEn: 想 is followed directly by an action.

points.name: 连动句（1）
points.explainEn: Use two verbs in order when one person does two connected actions.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词1 +（地点）+ 动词2

examples.en: I go to school to study.
I go to the supermarket to buy apples.
He goes to the cinema to watch a movie.

exercises.q: 排序：学校 / 我 / 去 / 学习
exercises.body: 学校 / 我 / 去 / 学习

exercises.q: 翻译：He goes to the cinema to watch a movie.
exercises.body: He goes to the cinema to watch a movie.

points.note: 动作按照实际发生顺序排列。
points.noteEn: Actions are ordered as they actually happen.

points.name: 疑问代词“怎么”
points.explainEn: Use 怎么 before a verb to ask “how”.
points.structure: 主语 + 怎么 + 动词？

examples.en: How do you go to school?
How do you read this character?
How do you write your name?

exercises.q: 翻译：How do you read this character?
exercises.body: How do you read this character?

exercises.q: 排序：怎么 / 名字 / 写 / 你的
exercises.body: 怎么 / 名字 / 写 / 你的

points.note: “怎么”主要询问动作的方法或方式。
points.noteEn: 怎么 mainly asks the method or manner of an action.

points.name: 时间的表达（2）：钟点
points.explainEn: Use 点 and 分 for clock time. 半 means half past.
points.structure: 小时 + 点 + 分；X点半
points.note: 钟点表达按“小时→分钟”的顺序。
points.noteEn: Clock time goes hour → minutes.

points.name: 语气助词“吧”（1）：建议、商量
points.explainEn: Add 吧 at the end to make a suggestion or discuss a plan softly.
points.structure: 建议句 + 吧

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's go watch a movie.
把句子变得更柔和：你休息一下。

points.note: “吧”让建议、商量或请求的语气更柔和。
points.noteEn: 吧 softens a suggestion, consultation or request.

points.name: 副词、时间词语作状语的位置
points.pinyin: fùcí, shíjiān cíyǔ zuò zhuàngyǔ de wèizhi
points.explainEn: Adverbs and time expressions usually go before the verb or adjective.
points.structure: 主语 +（副词/时间）+ 动词/形容词

examples.en: I go to the cinema in the afternoon.
He finishes work at six in the evening.

exercises.q: 排序：我 / 明天 / 上课
翻译：He finishes work at six in the evening.
exercises.body: He finishes work at six in the evening.

points.note: 时间一般放在主要动词前。
points.noteEn: Time expressions generally go before the main verb.

points.name: 语气助词“呢”（2）：强调已确认的情况
points.explainEn: Use 呢 at the end of a statement to emphasize a situation that is true now or already known.
points.structure: 陈述句 + 呢

examples.en: I still have class tomorrow afternoon.
I still have something to do tonight.

exercises.q: 翻译：I still have something to do tonight.
exercises.body: I still have something to do tonight.

exercises.q: 选择：强调已知情况可在句末加（呢 / 吗）。
exercises.body: 强调已知情况可在句末加（呢 / 吗）。

points.note: 和第4课询问“你呢？”不同，这里的“呢”用于陈述句末加强语气。
points.noteEn: Unlike the 你呢? of Lesson 4, this 呢 ends a statement to add emphasis.

points.name: 方位词
points.explainEn: Use position words such as 上、下、里、外、前、后 to say where something is.
points.structure: 名词 + 方位词 / 方位词 + 的 + 名词

examples.en: The book is on the table.
The hospital is in front of the school.

exercises.q: 翻译：The hospital is in front of the school.
exercises.body: The hospital is in front of the school.

points.note: 本册先掌握最常见的方位词和“边”形式。
points.noteEn: First master the common location words and the …边 forms.

points.name: 介词“在”表示动作发生的处所
points.explainEn: Use 在 + place before a verb to say where an action happens.
points.structure: 主语 + 在 + 地点 + 动词

examples.en: My father works at a hospital.

exercises.q: 翻译：My father works at a hospital.
exercises.body: My father works at a hospital.

exercises.q: 排序：在 / 他 / 家 / 休息
exercises.body: 在 / 他 / 家 / 休息

points.note: “在 + 地点”放在动作前面。
points.noteEn: 在 + place goes before the action.

points.name: 能愿动词“能”
points.explainEn: Use 能 + verb for ability or possibility because conditions allow it.
points.structure: 主语 + 能 + 动词

exercises.q: 改成否定句：他今天能上班。

points.note: “会”强调学会的技能；“能”更常表示条件允许或实际能力。
points.noteEn: 会 stresses a learned skill; 能 stresses being allowed/able.

lessons.title: 我明天上午在学校学习

points.name: 存现句（1）：地点 + 有 + 名词
points.explainEn: Use place + 有 + noun to say that something or someone exists in a place.
points.structure: 地点 + 有 + 数量 + 名词

examples.en: There is a hospital in the school.
There is a book on the table.
There are three people at home.

exercises.q: 翻译：There are three people at home.
exercises.body: There are three people at home.

exercises.q: 排序：有 / 学校里 / 一个医院
exercises.body: 有 / 学校里 / 一个医院

points.note: 这里的“有”重点是表示某处存在某人或某物。
points.noteEn: Here 有 stresses that someone/something exists at a place.

points.name: 时间词语和处所词语同时作状语的顺序
points.pinyin: shíjiān cíyǔ hé chùsuǒ cíyǔ tóngshí zuò zhuàngyǔ de shùnxù
points.explainEn: When both time and place come before a verb, time usually comes before place.
points.structure: 主语 + 时间 + 在 + 地点 + 动词

examples.zh: 我明天上午在学校学习。
examples.en: I will study at school tomorrow morning.
He works at the hospital today.
I rest at home in the afternoon.

exercises.q: 排序：我 / 明天上午 / 在学校 / 学习
exercises.a: 我明天上午在学校学习。
exercises.body: 我 / 明天上午 / 在学校 / 学习

exercises.q: 翻译：He works at the hospital today.
exercises.body: He works at the hospital today.

points.note: 基本顺序：时间在前，处所在后，最后是主要动作。
points.noteEn: Basic order: time first, place next, then the main action.

points.name: “第”表示序数
points.explainEn: Put 第 before a number to mean “first, second, third…”.
points.structure: 第 + 数词 (+ 名词/量词)

exercises.q: 排序：第三 / 今天 / 天 / 是
exercises.body: 第三 / 今天 / 天 / 是

points.note: “第”把普通数词变成序数。
points.noteEn: 第 turns a plain number into an ordinal.

points.name: 钱数的表达
points.explainEn: Use number + 元/块 to say a price. 块 is common in spoken Chinese.
points.structure: 数字 + 元/块（钱）

exercises.q: 翻译：This book is twenty yuan.

points.note: “元”较正式，“块”是常用口语。
points.noteEn: 元 is formal; 块 is the everyday spoken word.

points.name: 形容词谓语句
points.explainEn: An adjective can be the predicate directly. Do not add 是 before a normal adjective.
points.structure: 主语 +（很/真/太）+ 形容词

examples.en: The apples here are really cheap!

points.note: 初级阶段可记：形容词前一般不用“是”。
points.noteEn: At this level: don't use 是 before an adjective.

points.name: 疑问代词“怎么样”
points.explainEn: Use 怎么样 to ask “how is it / what is it like?”.
points.structure: 话题 + 怎么样？

exercises.q: 翻译：What is your school like?
排序：怎么样 / 今天天气

points.note: “怎么”多问方法；“怎么样”多问情况或评价。
points.noteEn: 怎么 asks how (method); 怎么样 asks about a situation or opinion.

points.name: 正反问
points.explainEn: Repeat the positive and negative form to make an A-not-A question.
points.structure: V不V？ / Adj不Adj？ / 是不是？

examples.en: Are you going to school or not?

exercises.q: 把句子变成正反问：你去学校。

points.note: 正反问句末一般不用“吗”。
points.noteEn: A yes-no (V-not-V) question doesn't take 吗.

points.name: 时间副词“在 / 正在”表示动作进行
points.explainEn: Use 在/正在 before a verb to show an action is happening now.
points.structure: 主语 + 在/正在 + 动词

exercises.q: 选择：表示动作正在进行用（正在 / 第）。
exercises.body: 表示动作正在进行用（正在 / 第）。

points.note: “正在”的进行意味比“在”更强。
points.noteEn: 正在 signals "in progress" more strongly than 在.

points.name: 能愿动词“要”
points.explainEn: Use 要 + verb to say you want, need, or plan to do something.
points.structure: 主语 + 要 + 动词

examples.en: I want to go to university.
I have class tomorrow / I need to attend class tomorrow.
He plans to go to Beijing.

exercises.q: 翻译：I want to go to university.
exercises.body: I want to go to university.

points.note: 本册重点理解“要”表示愿望、需要或近期计划。
points.noteEn: Focus: 要 for a wish, need, or near-future plan.

points.name: 非主谓句
points.explainEn: Some short Chinese sentences do not need a normal subject-predicate structure, especially weather expressions.
points.structure: 动词/形容词性短语独立成句

exercises.q: 选择：天气句可直接说（下雨了 / 天是下雨了）。
exercises.body: 天气句可直接说（下雨了 / 天是下雨了）。

points.note: 天气、自然现象等常可以不用明确主语。
points.noteEn: Weather and natural phenomena often need no explicit subject.

points.name: 语气助词“了”（1）：表示新情况或变化
points.explainEn: Use sentence-final 了 to show a new situation or change.
points.structure: 句子 + 了

exercises.q: 翻译：I am not busy anymore.
选择：表示情况变化在句末用（了 / 吗）。
exercises.body: 表示情况变化在句末用（了 / 吗）。

points.note: 这里的“了”强调变化；第14课学习动作完成的“了（2）”。
points.noteEn: Here 了 marks change; Lesson 14 covers the completion 了(2).

points.name: “太……了”格式
points.explainEn: Use 太 + adjective + 了 to mean “too… / so…”.
points.structure: 太 + 形容词 + 了

exercises.q: 翻译：This apple is too expensive.

points.note: 既可表示“太……”，也可用于强烈感叹。
points.noteEn: Can mean "too…" or a strong exclamation.

points.name: 能愿动词“可以”
points.explainEn: Use 可以 to say “may / can” when asking or giving permission.
points.structure: 主语 + 可以 + 动词

exercises.q: 改成否定：这里可以吸烟。

points.note: 本册重点是许可、允许的“可以”。
points.noteEn: Focus: 可以 for permission/allowing.

points.name: “动词 + 一下”结构
points.explainEn: Use verb + 一下 for a short action or to make a request softer.
points.structure: 动词 + 一下

examples.en: I want to rest for a moment.

exercises.q: 把句子说得更柔和：你看。

points.note: 常用于短暂动作和礼貌请求。
points.noteEn: Used for brief actions and polite requests.

points.name: 双宾语句（1）
points.explainEn: Some verbs can take two objects: a person and a thing.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 人 + 事物

examples.en: Please give me a cup of tea.
The teacher gives me a book.

exercises.q: 翻译：The teacher gives me a book.
exercises.body: The teacher gives me a book.

exercises.q: 排序：一个苹果 / 妈妈 / 给我
exercises.body: 一个苹果 / 妈妈 / 给我

points.note: 本课先掌握“给 + 人 + 东西”的双宾语结构。
points.noteEn: First master the double-object pattern 给 + person + thing.

points.name: 动态助词“了”（2）：表示动作完成
points.explainEn: Put 了 after a verb to show a completed action.
points.structure: 动词 + 了 + 宾语

examples.en: He drank a cup of tea.

exercises.q: 翻译：He drank a cup of tea.
exercises.body: He drank a cup of tea.

exercises.q: 排序：两个苹果 / 买了 / 我
exercises.body: 两个苹果 / 买了 / 我

points.note: 和第12课句末“了（变化）”区分：这里重点是动作已经完成。
points.noteEn: Unlike the change 了 of Lesson 12, this stresses a completed action.

points.name: 离合词（1）
points.explainEn: Some two-part verbs can be separated by words such as 了 or a quantity.
points.structure: 动词成分 + 了/数量 + 名词成分

exercises.q: 选择：正确的是（睡了一觉 / 睡觉了一）。
exercises.body: 正确的是（睡了一觉 / 睡觉了一）。

points.note: 离合词形式像一个词，但中间可以插入“了、数量”等成分。
points.noteEn: Separable words look like one word but can take 了/quantity inside.

points.name: 范围副词“都”
points.explainEn: Use 都 before the predicate to mean “all / both”.
points.structure: 复数主语/范围 + 都 + 谓语

examples.en: Dad and Mom are both at home.

exercises.q: 翻译：These apples are all cheap.
排序：都 / 爸爸妈妈 / 在家
exercises.body: 都 / 爸爸妈妈 / 在家

points.note: “都”通常放在主要动词或形容词前。
points.noteEn: 都 usually goes before the main verb or adjective.

points.name: 并列复句“……，还 / 也……”
points.explainEn: Use 也 to add the same kind of information; use 还 to add one more related point.

examples.zh: 我喜欢这个，也喜欢那个。
examples.en: I like this one, and I also like that one.

examples.zh: 我喜欢喝茶，还喜欢吃中国菜。
examples.en: I like drinking tea, and I also like Chinese food.

examples.zh: 王老师是北京人，李文也是北京人。
examples.en: Teacher Wang is from Beijing, and Li Wen is also from Beijing.

exercises.q: 填空：我喜欢这个，___喜欢那个。
填空：我想去北京，___想去西安。
翻译：Li Wen is also from Beijing.
exercises.body: Li Wen is also from Beijing.

points.note: “也”常表示另一人/事物情况相同；“还”常表示在已有信息上再增加一项。
points.noteEn: 也 marks "same for another"; 还 adds one more item.
